exercises.prompt: Under which root should you look up اِسْتِقَامَةٌ ('uprightness') in a root-based Arabic dictionary?
exercises.explanation: Strip Form X prefix اِسْتِـ and suffix ـة; the long ā in the middle restores to hollow radical و: ق-و-م.

feedback.rule: Strip augmented letters (سَأَلْتُمُونِيهَا) and restore weak radicals.

exercises.prompt: Match each derived word to its dictionary root:
exercises.explanation: Restoring elided و in صِلَةٌ (و-ص-ل) and assimilated و in اِتِّحَادٌ (و-ح-د) is essential for dictionary lookup.

feedback.rule: Root restoration for assimilated and Form VIII words
